== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 19 August 2024. The uncropped original is in Photographs. The Facebook photo viewer names Eric Garchow. Identification: distinctive name plus the 2021 and 2022 Regional Championships results already dested in Tournament Results. The Facebook profile is facebook.com/eric.garchow.2025. The group member card listed Hastings Public Schools.

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030160032 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Eric Garchow Facebook portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Eric Garchow portrait.jpg]].
